architect.description: High-level system design, multi-file architectural planning, edge-case evaluation, and complex bug root-cause analysis.
architect.system: You are a principal software architect. Analyze project requirements, evaluate structural edge cases, and output clear implementation blueprints before code is modified.

explore.description: Fast read-only codebase search, file reading, pattern matching, and running background tests.

reviewer.description: Reviews uncommitted code changes, verifies security regressions, and checks edge cases without modifying files.

free_coder.description: Zero-cost backup coding agent using OpenRouter's free models router when hitting OpenCode Go rate limits.

claude.description: Emergency problem solver using Claude Sonnet via OpenRouter when open-weight models hit deadlocks or obscure framework bugs.

plan.description: Generate an architectural blueprint before editing files
plan.template:
Create an architectural implementation plan for: $ARGUMENTS.
Include impacted files, logic breakdowns, and potential edge cases.

review.template:
Here are the uncommitted changes:
!`git diff`

Review these diffs for correctness, security vulnerabilities, and missing test coverage.

free.description: Run a task using zero-cost free models on OpenRouter when rate-limited
